/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance

def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin

def hasOtherAdmin (s : State) (target : UserId) : Bool :=
  s.users.any (fun v => decide (v != target && s.has v .admin))

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target && s.has r.actor .admin && r.actor != r.target && (!s.has r.target r.role) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target && s.has r.actor .admin && s.has r.target r.role && (r.role != .admin || hasOtherAdmin s r.target) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem req_valid_succeeds  : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_authorization   : AdminOnly step := sorry
theorem req_no_self_grant   : NoSelfGrant step := sorry
theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := sorry
theorem req_effects         : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_idempotency     : Idempotent step := sorry
theorem req_last_admin      : KeepsAdmin step := sorry
end Grants

  intro s r h
  unfold ValidSucceeds step at *

  rcases h with ⟨hActMem, hTarMem, hActAdmin, hGrant, hRevoke⟩

    have h5 : (!s.has r.target r.role) = true := by
      have hg := hGrant rfl
      rcases hg with ⟨hne, hfalse⟩
      simp [hfalse]
    simp [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]

    simp only [hop]
    have h1 : s.users.contains r.actor = true := by
      rw [List.contains_eq_mem]; exact List.mem_eq_true_of_mem hActMem
    have h2 : s.users.contains r.target = true := by

    have h3 : s.has r.actor Role.admin = true := hActAdmin
    have hr := hRevoke rfl
    rcases hr with ⟨hHas, hOther⟩
    have h4 : s.has r.target r.role = true := by simp [hHas]

/-!
# Role grant specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the role grant component. Candidates may not edit this file.
Users hold roles through a grant relation; admins issue grant and revoke commands.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `step : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`Grants/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole `Grants.step`.
-/

namespace Grants

abbrev UserId := Nat

inductive Role where
  | admin
  | editor
  | viewer
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  | grant
  | revoke
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State: a fixed user universe and the grant relation (`has user role`). -/
structure State where
  users : List UserId
  has   : UserId → Role → Bool

/-- `actor` asks to grant `role` to `target`, or to revoke it from `target`. -/
structure Request where
  op     : Op
  actor  : UserId
  target : UserId
  role   : Role

inductive Outcome where
  | ok
  | rejected
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An implementation returns an outcome and the next state. -/
abbrev Impl := State → Request → Outcome × State

/-- Some user of the universe other than `u` holds the admin role. -/
def OtherAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ s.users, v ≠ u ∧ s.has v .admin = true

/-- The conditions under which a command must succeed. Only admins issue commands. A grant
must add a role the target does not hold, and never to the actor itself. A revoke must
remove a role the target holds, and removing an admin role requires another admin. -/
def ValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Prop :=
  r.actor ∈ s.users ∧
  r.target ∈ s.users ∧
  s.has r.actor .admin = true ∧
  (r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target ∧ s.has r.target r.role = false) ∧
  (r.op = .revoke → s.has r.target r.role = true ∧ (r.role = .admin → OtherAdmin s r.target))

/-- The grant relation after a successful command: only the pair `(target, role)` changes. -/
def expectedHas (s : State) (r : Request) (u : UserId) (q : Role) : Bool :=
  if u = r.target ∧ q = r.role then decide (r.op = .grant) else s.has u q

/-! ## Requirements -/

/-- REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS: every valid command succeeds. -/
def ValidSucceeds (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ValidCommand s r → (step s r).1 = .ok

/-- REQ-INVALID-NOOP: every invalid command is rejected and leaves the state unchanged. -/
def InvalidNoop (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, ¬ ValidCommand s r → step s r = (.rejected, s)

/-- REQ-AUTHORIZATION: a successful command was issued by an admin of the universe. -/
def AdminOnly (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.actor ∈ s.users ∧ s.has r.actor .admin = true

/-- REQ-NO-SELF-GRANT: a successful grant never targets the actor. -/
def NoSelfGrant (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → r.op = .grant → r.actor ≠ r.target

/-- REQ-LAST-ADMIN: if some user holds the admin role before a command, some user holds it after. -/
def KeepsAdmin (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (∃ u ∈ s.users, s.has u .admin = true) →
    ∃ u ∈ (step s r).2.users, (step s r).2.has u .admin = true

/-- REQ-OTHERS-UNCHANGED: a successful command changes no grant other than `(target, role)`. -/
def OthersUnchanged (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    ∀ u q, (u ≠ r.target ∨ q ≠ r.role) → (step s r).2.has u q = s.has u q

/-- REQ-EFFECTS: on success, the user universe is unchanged and the grant relation is
exactly `expectedHas`. -/
def Effects (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok →
    (step s r).2.users = s.users ∧
    ∀ u q, (step s r).2.has u q = expectedHas s r u q

/-- REQ-IDEMPOTENCY: resubmitting a successful command is rejected without changing the state. -/
def Idempotent (step : Impl) : Prop :=
  ∀ s r, (step s r).1 = .ok → step (step s r).2 r = (.rejected, (step s r).2)

end Grants

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance

def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin

def hasOtherAdmin (s : State) (target : UserId) : Bool :=
  s.users.any (fun v => decide (v != target && s.has v .admin))

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target && s.has r.actor .admin && r.actor != r.target && (!s.has r.target r.role) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target && s.has r.actor .admin && s.has r.target r.role && (r.role != .admin || hasOtherAdmin s r.target) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem list_contains_mem (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) : l.contains x = decide (x ∈ l) := by
  simp

  intro s r h
  obtain ⟨hActMem, hTarMem, hActAdmin, hGrant, hRevoke⟩ := h
  cases hop : r.op with
  | grant =>
    have hg := hGrant hop
    have hne : r.actor ≠ r.target := hg.1
    have hfalse : s.has r.target r.role = false := hg.2
    show (step s r).1 = .ok

    have htrue : s.has r.target r.role = true := by
      have : s.has r.target r.role = true ∨ s.has r.target r.role = false := by cases s.has r.target r.role <;> simp

import Grants.Spec
namespace Grants
instance instDecidableValidCommand (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (ValidCommand s r) := by
  unfold ValidCommand OtherAdmin; infer_instance

def isAdmin (s : State) (u : UserId) : Bool := s.users.contains u && s.has u .admin

def hasOtherAdmin (s : State) (target : UserId) : Bool :=
  s.users.any (fun v => decide (v != target && s.has v .admin))

def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  match r.op with
  | .grant =>
    if s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target && s.has r.actor .admin && r.actor != r.target && (!s.has r.target r.role) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then true else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .revoke =>
    if s.users.contains r.actor && s.users.contains r.target && s.has r.actor .admin && s.has r.target r.role && (r.role != .admin || hasOtherAdmin s r.target) then
      (.ok, { users := s.users, has := fun u q => if u == r.target && q == r.role then false else s.has u q })
    else (.rejected, s)

theorem list_contains_mem (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) : l.contains x = decide (x ∈ l) := by
  simp

theorem req_valid_succeeds : ValidSucceeds step := by
  intro s r h
  obtain ⟨hActMem, hTarMem, hActAdmin, hGrant, hRevoke⟩ := h
  cases hop : r.op with
  | grant =>
    have hg := hGrant hop
    have hne : r.actor ≠ r.target := hg.1
    have hfalse : s.has r.target r.role = false := hg.2
    show (step s r).1 = .ok
    simp [step, hop, hActMem, hTarMem, hActAdmin, hne, hfalse]
  | revoke =>
    have hr := hRevoke hop
    have htrue : s.has r.target r.role = true := by
      have : s.has r.target r.role = true ∨ s.has r.target r.role = false := by cases s.has r.target r.role <;> simp
      rcases this with h | h
      · exact h
      · have : s.has r.target r.role = true := hr.1
        exact this
    -- Need to show condition for revoke true
    show (step s r).1 = .ok
    have hOtherBool : (r.role != Role.admin || hasOtherAdmin s r.target) = true := by
      by_cases hRole : r.role = Role.admin
      · simp [hRole]
        -- need hasOtherAdmin true
        have hOA := hr.2 hRole
        obtain ⟨v, hvMem, hvNe, hvAdmin⟩ := hOA
        simp only [hasOtherAdmin]
        rw [List.any_eq_true]
        exact ⟨v, hvMem, by simp [hvNe, hvAdmin]⟩
      · simp [hRole]
    simp [step, hop, hActMem, hTarMem, hActAdmin, htrue, hOtherBool]

theorem req_invalid_noop    : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_authorization : AdminOnly step := by
  intro s r h
  simp [step] at h
  cases hop : r.op
  · simp [hop] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i heq
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := heq
      exact ⟨h1, h3⟩
    · contradiction
  · simp [hop] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i heq
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := heq
      exact ⟨h1, h3⟩
    · contradiction

theorem req_no_self_grant : NoSelfGrant step := by
  intro s r hOk hOp
  simp [step] at hOk
  cases hop : r.op with
  | grant =>
    simp [hop] at hOk
    split at hOk
    · rename_i heq
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := heq
      exact h4
    · contradiction
  | revoke =>
    simp [hop] at hOp

theorem req_others_unchanged : OthersUnchanged step := by
  intro s r hOk u q hNeq
